_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in the Complacency band with pinned sentiment/funding and no price break; 5% rung-change hit rate and ±1 rule forbid forcing Anxiety or Disbelief off a bottom analog alone.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative silent on forward phase, only flow headline; no bullish override from writer
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains range-bound with fear_greed 45-55 and funding only mildly positive
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed <40 with funding negative and dead ETF flows, or sustained upside break with ETF flows recovering through mid-range
